events.title: Hurricane Katrina strikes
events.description: The hurricane devastates Gulf Coast communities and creates an enormous need for rescue and recovery.

events.title: Apple announces the iPhone
events.description: The company presents a touchscreen device combining a phone, music player and internet functions.

events.title: Bear Stearns faces a rescue deal
events.description: The Federal Reserve approves financing for a deal involving the troubled investment bank and JPMorgan Chase.

what_happened_next.text:
The international share basket nearly tripled, leading this set. Costco more than doubled, while Merck lost value. Intel gained less than the broad US basket. The starting article’s hopeful investment ideas were opinions to examine, not instructions guaranteed to work.

The years ahead included Hurricane Katrina, Apple’s announcement of the iPhone and a rescue deal involving Bear Stearns in March 2008. The window ends that month. Later stages of the financial crisis do not belong inside this five-year return, even though a reader today may know what followed.

Merck’s loss is worth noticing because a dividend is money paid to shareholders, not a shield against a falling share price. A company can make payments and still leave an investor with less overall. Meanwhile, the international basket spread money across many businesses outside the US. The comparison does not identify a permanent winner; it shows the limits of the confident investment suggestions that were available at the starting date.

reflection.what_people_were_focused_on: The Iraq invasion dominated attention. Some economists hoped less uncertainty would lift spending, while daily life and new products continued.
reflection.what_actually_mattered: The risks of each company still mattered. Even a medicine maker paying dividends could lose value for its shareholders. The international share basket followed a different path.
reflection.what_faded_away: A confident wartime forecast did not tell you which investment would lead. Calling a stock a safe haven did not remove its risks.
reflection.what_nobody_knew: Nobody knew the coming company surprises or financial stress. This window ends in March 2008, so later events are outside its return chart.
